_comment: news.py: headlines only (title, link, time, summary from each feed; no article pages), honest UA, robots.txt honoured, polled every 20 s. Several publishers' terms restrict automated or commercial use (see SOURCES.md): personal use is your call.

www.moneycontrol.com.access: terms (4.4(iii)) bar bots; news sitemap listed in robots.txt (its RSS stopped in 2024); headlines for personal use; ttl 30 = its max-age, no ETag

feeds.feedburner.com.access: NDTV's public Feedburner feeds; ndtvprofit.com itself blocks scripts

www.zeebiz.com.access: robots.txt allows generic bots (blocks named AI crawlers)

www.cnbctv18.com.access: Network18 terms restrict machine use; headlines for personal use

www.livemint.com.access: terms restrict crawlers; headlines for personal use

www.bseindia.com.access: exchange announcements RSS; pubDate is IST

x.com.access: robots.txt disallows all bots: news.py reads X only through the official API (X_BEARER_TOKEN)
